children: Decentralized oracle Switchboard said reports surfaced overnight that its Move-based network implementation may have been compromised, prompting contributors to coordinate with relevant teams and security organizations. According to Foresight News, Switchboard has suspended network services on Aptos, Sui, Iota, and Movement.

Switchboard said it has not received reports of a similar intrusion affecting its Solana implementation. However, it advised users to migrate to other solutions at least temporarily while the issue is investigated, and said more details will be released later.

title: Switchboard Suspends Aptos, Sui, Iota, and Movement Services After Reported Move Network Intrusion
